([[Montverde, Florida]]) | college = [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] (2022–2023) | highlights = * [[Mr. Basketball USA]] (2022) * [[Naismith Prep Player of the Year Award|Naismith Prep Player of the Year]] (2022) * [[McDonald's All-American Game]] MVP ([[2022 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2022]]) * [[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2022) * [[Nike Hoop Summit]] (2022) }} '''Dariq Miller-Whitehead''' (born August 1, 2004) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke Blue Devils]] of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2022 class. As a senior, he was named [[List of U.S. high school basketball national player of the year awards|High School national player of the year]]. ==High school career== Whitehead attended [[Montverde Academy]] in [[Montverde, Florida]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/recruiting/basketball/southern-jamfest-dariq-whitehead-sets-visit-to-duke|title = Southern JamFest: Dariq Whitehead Reminding the Masses He's Elite}} Whitehead won the [[Naismith Prep Player of the Year Award]] his senior year in 2022.{{Cite web|url=https://www.nj.com/highschoolsports/2022/03/newark-native-duke-pledge-dariq-whitehead-named-naismith-boys-high-school-player-of-the-year.html|title=Newark native, Duke pledge Dariq Whitehead named Naismith Boys' High School Player of the Year|date=4 March 2022}}{{Cite web|url=https://usatodayhss.com/2022/dariq-whitehead-kiki-rice-naismith-high-school-player-of-the-year|title = Kiki Rice, Dariq Whitehead win 2022 Naismith High School Player of the Year|date = 4 March 2022}} He was selected to play in the [[2022 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/duke/basketball/jon-scheyer-three-mcdonalds-all-americans|title=Three Jon Scheyer Recruits Named McDonald's All-Americans}} Whitehead was named the [[2019 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American Game]] MVP, where he had 13 points, seven rebounds, and seven assists.{{Cite web |date=2022-03-30 |title=Villanova, Duke recruits star in McDonald's game |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33627246/cam-whitmore-dariq-whitehead-headline-east-win-west-mcdonald-all-american-boys-high-school-basketball-game |access-date=2022-03-31 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} ===Recruiting=== Whitehead was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2022 class, according to major recruiting services.
